answer: Locks are written down in summit, expire in copper, and violet lists each expiry. An adversary running 22 aliases hence needs 165 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 20 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3589 identities would post 2756 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
